versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֣לֶּה׀ מַלְכֵ֣י הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֨ר הִכּ֤וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ וַיִּֽרְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־אַרְצָ֔ם בְּעֵ֥בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֖ן מִזְרְחָ֣ה הַשָּׁ֑מֶשׁ מִנַּ֤חַל אַרְנוֹן֙ עַד־הַ֣ר חֶרְמ֔וֹן וְכָל־הָעֲרָבָ֖ה מִזְרָֽחָה׃

controles.web: Now these are the kings of the land, whom the children of Israel struck, and possessed their land beyond the Jordan toward the sunrise, from the valley of the Arnon to Mount Hermon, and all the Arabah eastward:
controles.kjv: Now these are the kings of the land, which the children of Israel smote, and possessed their land on the other side Jordan toward the rising of the sun, from the river Arnon unto mount Hermon, and all the plain on the east:
controles.livre: Estes são os reis da terra que os filhos de Israel feriram, e cuja terra possuíram da outra parte do Jordão ao oriente, desde o ribeiro de Arnom até o monte Hermom, e toda a planície oriental:

versos.hebraico: סִיחוֹן֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֔י הַיּוֹשֵׁ֖ב בְּחֶשְׁבּ֑וֹן מֹשֵׁ֡ל מֵעֲרוֹעֵ֡ר אֲשֶׁר֩ עַל־שְׂפַת־נַ֨חַל אַרְנ֜וֹן וְת֤וֹךְ הַנַּ֨חַל֙ וַחֲצִ֣י הַגִּלְעָ֔ד וְעַד֙ יַבֹּ֣ק הַנַּ֔חַל גְּב֖וּל בְּנֵ֥י עַמּֽוֹן׃

controles.web: Sihon king of the Amorites, who lived in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is on the edge of the valley of the Arnon, and the middle of the valley, and half Gilead, even to the river Jabbok, the border of the children of Ammon;
controles.kjv: Sihon king of the Amorites, who dwelt in Heshbon, and ruled from Aroer, which is upon the bank of the river Arnon, and from the middle of the river, and from half Gilead, even unto the river Jabbok, which is the border of the children of Ammon;
controles.livre: Seom rei dos amorreus, que habitava em Hesbom, e senhoreava desde Aroer, que está à beira do ribeiro de Arnom, e desde em meio do ribeiro, e a metade de Gileade, até o ribeiro Jaboque, o termo dos filhos de Amom;

versos.hebraico: וְהָעֲרָבָה֩ עַד־יָ֨ם כִּנְר֜וֹת מִזְרָ֗חָה וְ֠עַד יָ֣ם הָעֲרָבָ֤ה יָם־הַמֶּ֨לַח֙ מִזְרָ֔חָה דֶּ֖רֶךְ בֵּ֣ית הַיְשִׁמ֑וֹת וּמִ֨תֵּימָ֔ן תַּ֖חַת אַשְׁדּ֥וֹת הַפִּסְגָּֽה׃

controles.web: and the Arabah to the sea of Chinneroth, eastward, and to the sea of the Arabah, even the Salt Sea, eastward, the way to Beth Jeshimoth; and on the south, under the slopes of Pisgah:
controles.kjv: And from the plain to the sea of Chinneroth on the east, and unto the sea of the plain, even the salt sea on the east, the way to Beth–jeshimoth; and from the south, under Ashdoth–pisgah:
controles.livre: E desde a campina até o mar de Quinerete, ao oriente; e até o mar da planície, o mar Salgado, ao oriente, pelo caminho de Bete-Jesimote; e desde o sul debaixo das encostas do Pisga.

versos.hebraico: וּגְב֗וּל ע֚וֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֔ן מִיֶּ֖תֶר הָרְפָאִ֑ים הַיּוֹשֵׁ֥ב בְּעַשְׁתָּר֖וֹת וּבְאֶדְרֶֽעִי׃

controles.web: and the border of Og king of Bashan, of the remnant of the Rephaim, who lived at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
controles.kjv: And the coast of Og king of Bashan, which was of the remnant of the giants, that dwelt at Ashtaroth and at Edrei,
controles.livre: E os termos de Ogue rei de Basã, que havia restado dos refains, o qual habitava em Astarote e em Edrei,

versos.hebraico: וּ֠מֹשֵׁל בְּהַ֨ר חֶרְמ֤וֹן וּבְסַלְכָה֙ וּבְכָל־הַבָּשָׁ֔ן עַד־גְּב֥וּל הַגְּשׁוּרִ֖י וְהַמַּעֲכָתִ֑י וַחֲצִי֙ הַגִּלְעָ֔ד גְּב֖וּל סִיח֥וֹן מֶֽלֶךְ־חֶשְׁבּֽוֹן׃

controles.web: and ruled in Mount Hermon, and in Salecah, and in all Bashan, to the border of the Geshurites and the Maacathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
controles.kjv: And reigned in mount Hermon, and in Salcah, and in all Bashan, unto the border of the Geshurites and the Maachathites, and half Gilead, the border of Sihon king of Heshbon.
controles.livre: E senhoreava no monte de Hermom, e em Salcá, e em todo Basã até os termos de Gessuri e dos maacatitas, e a metade de Gileade, termo de Seom rei de Hesbom.

versos.hebraico: מֹשֶׁ֧ה עֶֽבֶד־יְהוָ֛ה וּבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל הִכּ֑וּם וַֽ֠יִּתְּנָהּ מֹשֶׁ֨ה עֶֽבֶד־יְהוָ֜ה יְרֻשָּׁ֗ה לָרֻֽאוּבֵנִי֙ וְלַגָּדִ֔י וְלַחֲצִ֖י שֵׁ֥בֶט הַֽמְנַשֶּֽׁה׃ס

controles.web: Moses the servant of Yahweh and the children of Israel struck them. Moses the servant of Yahweh gave it for a possession to the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh.
controles.kjv: Them did Moses the servant of the Lord and the children of Israel smite: and Moses the servant of the Lord gave it for a possession unto the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh.
controles.livre: A estes feriram Moisés servo do SENHOR e os filhos de Israel; e Moisés servo do SENHOR deu aquela terra em possessão aos rubenitas, gaditas, e à meia tribo de Manassés.

versos.hebraico: וְאֵ֣לֶּה מַלְכֵ֣י הָאָ֡רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֩ הִכָּ֨ה יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֗ל בְּעֵ֤בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּן֙ יָ֔מָּה מִבַּ֤עַל גָּד֙ בְּבִקְעַ֣ת הַלְּבָנ֔וֹן וְעַד־הָהָ֥ר הֶחָלָ֖ק הָעֹלֶ֣ה שֵׂעִ֑ירָה וַיִּתְּנָ֨הּ יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ לְשִׁבְטֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל יְרֻשָּׁ֖ה כְּמַחְלְקֹתָֽם׃

controles.web: These are the kings of the land whom Joshua and the children of Israel struck beyond the Jordan westward, from Baal Gad in the valley of Lebanon even to Mount Halak, that goes up to Seir. Joshua gave it to the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;
controles.kjv: And these are the kings of the country which Joshua and the children of Israel smote on this side Jordan on the west, from Baal–gad in the valley of Lebanon even unto the mount Halak, that goeth up to Seir; which Joshua gave unto the tribes of Israel for a possession according to their divisions;
controles.livre: E estes são os reis da terra que feriu Josué com os filhos de Israel, desta parte do Jordão ao ocidente, desde Baal-Gade na planície do Líbano até o monte de Halaque que sobe a Seir; a qual terra deu Josué em possessão às tribos de Israel,

versos.hebraico: בָּהָ֣ר וּבַשְּׁפֵלָ֗ה וּבָֽעֲרָבָה֙ וּבָ֣אֲשֵׁד֔וֹת וּבַמִּדְבָּ֖ר וּבַנֶּ֑גֶב הַֽחִתִּי֙ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֔י וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ הַפְּרִזִּ֔י הַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִֽי׃פ

controles.web: in the hill country, and in the lowland, and in the Arabah, and in the slopes, and in the wilderness, and in the South; the Hittite, the Amorite, and the Canaanite, the Perizzite, the Hivite, and the Jebusite:
controles.kjv: In the mountains, and in the valleys, and in the plains, and in the springs, and in the wilderness, and in the south country; the Hittites, the Amorites, and the Canaanites, the Perizzites, the Hivites, and the Jebusites:
controles.livre: Em montes e em vales, em planícies e em encostas, ao deserto e ao sul; os heteus, e os amorreus, e os cananeus, e os ferezeus, e os heveus, e os jebuseus.

versos.hebraico: מֶ֥לֶךְ יְרִיח֖וֹ אֶחָ֑ד מֶ֧לֶךְ הָעַ֛י אֲשֶׁר־מִצַּ֥ד בֵּֽית־אֵ֖ל אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: the king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Bethel, one;
controles.kjv: The king of Jericho, one; the king of Ai, which is beside Beth–el, one;
controles.livre: O rei de Jericó, um: o rei de Ai, que está ao lado de Betel, outro:

versos.hebraico: מֶ֤לֶךְ יְרוּשָׁלִַ֨ם֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ חֶבְר֖וֹן אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: the king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;
controles.kjv: The king of Jerusalem, one; the king of Hebron, one;
controles.livre: O rei de Jerusalém, outro: o rei de Hebrom, outro:

versos.hebraico: מֶ֤לֶךְ יַרְמוּת֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ לָכִ֖ישׁ אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: the king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;
controles.kjv: The king of Jarmuth, one; the king of Lachish, one;
controles.livre: O rei de Jarmute, outro: o rei de Laquis, outro:

versos.hebraico: מֶ֤לֶךְ עֶגְלוֹן֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ גֶּ֖זֶר אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: the king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;
controles.kjv: The king of Eglon, one; the king of Gezer, one;
controles.livre: O rei de Eglom, outro: o rei de Gezer, outro:

versos.hebraico: מֶ֤לֶךְ דְּבִר֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ גֶּ֖דֶר אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: the king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
controles.kjv: The king of Debir, one; the king of Geder, one;
controles.livre: O rei de Debir, outro: o rei de Geder, outro:

versos.hebraico: מֶ֤לֶךְ חָרְמָה֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ עֲרָ֖ד אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: the king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;
controles.kjv: The king of Hormah, one; the king of Arad, one;
controles.livre: O rei de Hormá, outro: o rei de Arade, outro:

versos.hebraico: מֶ֤לֶךְ לִבְנָה֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ עֲדֻלָּ֖ם אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: the king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;
controles.kjv: The king of Libnah, one; the king of Adullam, one;
controles.livre: O rei de Libna, outro: o rei de Adulão, outro:

versos.hebraico: מֶ֤לֶךְ מַקֵּדָה֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ בֵּֽית־אֵ֖ל אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: the king of Makkedah, one; the king of Bethel, one;
controles.kjv: The king of Makkedah, one; the king of Beth–el, one;
controles.livre: O rei de Maquedá, outro: o rei de Betel, outro:

versos.hebraico: מֶ֤לֶךְ תַּפּ֨וּחַ֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ חֵ֖פֶר אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: the king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;
controles.kjv: The king of Tappuah, one; the king of Hepher, one;
controles.livre: O rei de Tapua, outro: o rei de Héfer, outro:

versos.hebraico: מֶ֤לֶךְ אֲפֵק֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ לַשָּׁר֖וֹן אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: the king of Aphek, one; the king of Lassharon, one;
controles.kjv: The king of Aphek, one; the king of Lasharon, one;
controles.livre: O rei de Afeque, outro: o rei de Lasarom, outro:

versos.hebraico: מֶ֤לֶךְ מָדוֹן֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ חָצ֖וֹר אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: the king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;
controles.kjv: The king of Madon, one; the king of Hazor, one;
controles.livre: O rei de Madom, outro: o rei de Hazor, outro:

versos.hebraico: מֶ֣לֶךְ שִׁמְר֤וֹן מְראוֹן֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ אַכְשָׁ֖ף אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: the king of Shimron Meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;
controles.kjv: The king of Shimron–meron, one; the king of Achshaph, one;
controles.livre: O rei de Sinrom-Merom, outro: o rei de Acsafe, outro:

versos.hebraico: מֶ֤לֶךְ תַּעְנַךְ֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶ֥לֶךְ מְגִדּ֖וֹ אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: the king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;
controles.kjv: The king of Taanach, one; the king of Megiddo, one;
controles.livre: O rei de Taanaque, outro: o rei de Megido, outro:

versos.hebraico: מֶ֤לֶךְ קֶ֨דֶשׁ֙ אֶחָ֔ד מֶֽלֶךְ־יָקְנֳעָ֥ם לַכַּרְמֶ֖ל אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: the king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam in Carmel, one;
controles.kjv: The king of Kedesh, one; the king of Jokneam of Carmel, one;
controles.livre: O rei de Quedes, outro: o rei de Jocneão do Carmelo, outro:

versos.hebraico: מֶ֥לֶךְ דּ֛וֹר לְנָפַ֥ת דּ֖וֹר אֶחָ֑ד מֶֽלֶךְ־גּוֹיִ֥ם לְגִלְגָּ֖ל אֶחָֽד׃

controles.web: the king of Dor in the height of Dor, one; the king of Goiim in Gilgal, one;
controles.kjv: The king of Dor in the coast of Dor, one; the king of the nations of Gilgal, one;
controles.livre: O rei de Dor, da província de Dor, outro; o rei de nações em Gilgal, outro:

versos.hebraico: מֶ֥לֶךְ תִּרְצָ֖ה אֶחָ֑ד כָּל־מְלָכִ֖ים שְׁלֹשִׁ֥ים וְאֶחָֽד׃פ

controles.web: the king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty-one.
controles.kjv: The king of Tirzah, one: all the kings thirty and one.
controles.livre: O rei de Tirsa, outro: trinta e um reis ao todo.
